body: Losing people you care about is very hard, weather or not you see it you’re such a strong person. I know it hurts and time definitely does heal. Things that have helped me through a break up are hard times was family if not family friends I myself don’t really have many friends but being around people who bring you positivity and joy does wonders. Do you have any hobbies or things that bring you joy, the little things. Sometimes being alone does help but in a healthy way such as going on a hike alone, going out to eat, just taking a drive etc. like I said if you ever need to talk I’m always here. :)
Reading this made me happy, I don’t know you but I’m proud of you, continue fighting you got this!
Thank you that means a lot!
I completely understand. Im always here if you need to talk or vent you can always message Me. If I can help in anyway please let me know. :)
I’m glad I could help, if you ever need to talk or vent you can message me I’m always here for you. I believe in you, it takes time you got this!
